ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity dark charcoal pixels to high-intensity white pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels form a dense mottling of circular spots across both lobes, with solid high-intensity patches concentrated on the distal tips and lower leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations including several deep, irregular notches. Left lobe displays lower-amplitude, rhythmic scalloping.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a predominantly convex curve tapering toward sharp distal tips; trailing edge trajectory is heavily modified by irregular serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive distribution of high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (barnacle scars) across the entire visible surface, with a high-density cluster on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, near-vertical parallel linear white marks detected approximately 15% of the width to the right of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and deep jagged indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating historical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of distinct white 'ring' shapes concentrated in the lower central region near the fluke peduncle junction.
